400 Bad Request when audio format is unsupported

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "liter_llm.h"

int main(void) {
    const char* api_key = getenv("API_KEY");
    assert(api_key != NULL && "API_KEY must be set");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle create_transcription_request_handle = literllm_create_transcription_request_from_json("{\"file\":\"audio.xyz\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\"}");
    if (create_transcription_request_handle == 0) { return EXIT_SUCCESS; }
    LITERLLMAlefHandle client = literllm_create_client(api_key, NULL, (uint64_t)-1, (uint32_t)-1, NULL);
    assert(client != 0 && "failed to create client");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle result = literllm_default_client_transcribe(client, create_transcription_request_handle);
    if (result != 0) { return EXIT_FAILURE; }
    literllm_create_transcription_request_free(create_transcription_request_handle);
    literllm_default_client_free(client);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
